source_tags.wheelchair:description: Poor design. Approach & entry is difficult, due to loose gravel & 1 step.  Locking the door via a tiny handle is hard! Bad contrast makes it difficult for visually impaired people to navigate or operate "automatic" features such as water, soap & dryer.
